name: Email (IMAP/SMTP)
tagline: Read, search and send your email
description: Email lets agents read, search, send, reply to and organize mail in any IMAP and SMTP mailbox: Gmail, Google Workspace, Yahoo, iCloud, Zoho, Fastmail, GMX, AOL and most custom domains. The local server finds the mail servers from the address, so the connection needs only the address and a password. Use an app password where the provider offers one. The password goes only to your mail provider. Outlook and Hotmail are not supported yet.

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email from today.
Draft a reply to the latest email from my client and save it as a draft.
Find the invoice emails from last month and download their attachments.
List the newsletters in my inbox that are older than a week, and archive them after I confirm.

apps.name: Email
apps.description: Mail reading, search, sending, drafts, folders, templates and scheduled send, over a local MCP server that connects to the mailbox with IMAP and SMTP.

fields.label: App password
fields.hint: Gmail: turn on 2-Step Verification, then create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Use your normal password only if the provider has no app passwords.
